methodology.title: 2.1 Core Principle: Project-Based Synthesis
content: Problem: Students have learned over 20 irregular verbs and multiple narrative structures, but often struggle to combine them into a cohesive story.

Solution: This week involves creating an 8-page "Adventure Book." The physical pages force students to break down their narrative into Beginning, Middle (Events + Problem), and End, organically synthesizing all Block B grammar in a fun, personal project.

methodology.title: 2.2 Session Flow (120 Minutes)
content: Session 1: Draft the Beginning and first Events (Pages 1–3). Focus on movement and perception irregular verbs.
Session 2: Draft the Problem and Solution (Pages 4–6). Focus on accident irregular verbs and feelings.
Session 3: Draft the Ending and Lesson (Pages 7–8). Finalize the book and practice the oral presentation.

methodology.title: 2.4 Teacher Notes: Pull-Out Tasks & Communicative Task
content: S1 pull-out: Student picks a verb card ("went"), then makes a "Once upon a time" sentence.
S2 pull-out: Show a problem card (e.g., lost key). Student says "I lost my key. I felt worried."
Communicative task (Step 5 - 10 min): Story Exchange. Student A reads their Page 1 and 2. Student B must guess what happens on Page 3.
